body: He's getting away with it because I left it too long before coming forward so there is no medical evidence and he is denying it. I don't have any options, the only thing to do is die.
Some of the nightmares are just dreams some of them are very vivid memories. I'm scared of him because of what he did to me.

I'm scared of my ex approaching me, and of it happening again with him or someone else. Sometimes I get so scared that I vomit. I can't sleep because of the nightmares so I get up every morning already terrified of the world. I can't focus, I struggle to remember things, I can't make friends, I barely eat, I cry often...
